text:
release-manager: Heads-up — canary promo stuck. deploy-bot reports multipart artifact upload failing with 429 backoff, smoke tests failing intermittently. Holding release. /cc @alex @maria

deploy-bot: [automated] Upload attempt 6/10 failed: 429 Too Many Requests. Backoff increased to 30s. Artifact: registry.redwood.ai/redwood/canary/20260321-abc123.tar.gz

jamie: logs:
```
ERROR UploadService: multipart upload part 3: 429 rate_limit_exceeded
Retrying after backoff=30s (attempt=6)
```

alex: I'd prefer to pin to last good image: registry.redwood.ai/redwood/canary:20260320-def456 and manual-promote to unblock.

maria: Are smoke tests failing because artifact is corrupted/partial or because infra (redis/registry) had transient errors?

ken: I can run manual promote if we decide. Alternative quick fix: force single PUT (no multipart) for this artifact. deploy-bot supports env override: DEPLOY_USE_SINGLE_PART=1

sre-bot: Investigating registry throttling in eu-west-1. Seen a spike from CI runners causing 429s. Suggest short-term throttle: DEPLOY_MAX_PARALLEL_UPLOADS=2 and increase backoff multiplier.

jamie: command to promote if we pin:
```
deployctl promote --from-tag=20260320-def456 --to=canary --reason="hotfix pin after upload rate limit"
```

release-manager: Decision needed within 20m before change window. Options:
1) pin+manual promote
2) tweak deploybot to single-put + throttle
3) wait for registry fix (risky)

alex: I vote pin+promote. We can revert later if regression.

maria: :thumbsup: pin+promote. I'll run post-promote smoke tests.

ken: I'll stand by to do manual promote/rollback if needed. If we pin, update release notes to mention temporary pin.

jamie: I'll run promote and smoke tests in ~2m unless anyone objects.

release-manager: Proceed with option 1. @jamie go ahead. @sre-bot keep monitors on registry and alert if 429 rate persists.

deploy-bot: [automated] Promotion initiated by jamie. Pulling tag 20260320-def456 -> canary. Uploading artifact...

jamie: Smoke tests: all clear ✅

jamie: Updating release notes: "Canary pinned to 20260320-def456 due to registry multipart throttling; temporary measure. Will revert after registry throttle mitigation."
